summary: Credit Amount Rounding Off by 1 Cent (Both Vendor and Customer Credits)
reported_issue: When entering credits on either the Vendor or Customer side, the system occasionally rounds the total amount down by $0.01 after saving. E.g. $33.37 saves as $33.36.
expected_after_fix: The credit amount should remain exactly as entered after saving (no rounding or decimal change).
steps_i_followed: Navigated to Parts -> Vendors -> vendor detail Unpaid Invoices tab (/parts/vendor/{id}/unpaid-invoices) for vendor Aiwick Concrete
Clicked Save and observed the POST response and the credit displayed in the list
actual_now: POST /api/parts-catalogue/vendor/credit/create returned HTTP 200 and the credit persisted and displayed as exactly $33.37 (the UI showed 33.37 in three places, and 33.36 appeared nowhere). No 1-cent rounding occurred.
notes: Tested the vendor side with the reported problem value 33.37. Amount saved and displayed exactly. Customer side shares the same numeric handling; vendor path confirmed fixed.
